full_judgment: 3. Material facts necessary for disposal of the case are as follows:- The petitioner, ABC Attire Limited (hereinafter stated as the Company) is a private limited garments manufacturing company. In course of its business the Company obtained some loan for running factory from respondent No.9 i.e. Sonali Bank Limited, Dilkusha Corporate Branch, Dilkusha, Dhaka (in short, the Bank) but the Company could not repay the loan to the Bank. A good number of garment industries of the country had become sick and required to be restored. To rehabilitate such industries, the Ministry of Commerce formed a committee entitled "Committee on Restarting of Sick Garments Industries" (the Committee, in brief) through Gazette Notification dated 28-2-2005 published on 7-3-2005 in the Gazette (the Notification). The Company was listed as a sick garments industry by respondent No. 2 i.e. Secretary of Ministry of Commerce. The Committee submitted a report with certain recommendations to rehabilitate the sick garments industries for restarting (চালুকরন). The Committee registered 270 sick garments industries along with the Company for rehabilitation. Meanwhile, the Bank on 21-3-2001 instituted Title Suit No.69 of 2001 before the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Dhaka (hereinafter stated as the Adalat) for recovery of loan amounting to Tk. 4,59,97,042 as stood on 31-1-2000 and interest therein till realization impleading the Company and others as defendants of the suit. The suit was decreed in preliminary form on 12-9-2001 and final decree was drawn up on 13.4.2003. The judgment-debtors having failed to pay the decretal dues, the Bank filed Title Execution Case No. 160 of 2003 and the execution case was disposed of by issuing a certificate under section 33(5) of the Ain for khas possession and right to sell the mortgaged property in favour of the Bank on 24- 2-2008. Thereafter the Bank filed Title Execution Case No. 132 of 2009 for recovery of balance detrital dues and the said execution case is pending before the Adalat. Subsequently, International Commerce Finance Division of Sonali Bank (respondent No.8) issued a circular being Memo No. প্রধান কার্যালয় পরিপত্র নং- ৪১ আই টি এফ ডি/রপ্তানী/গার্মেন্টস/১০৭৮ 22-9-2010 with some guidelines (hereinafter mentioned as the Guidelines) relating to loan of 85 garments industries as per direction of the Government vide Memo No. অম/ব্যাআ প্রবি/ঋঃরুঃশি অধিশাখা/রূগ্ন শিপ্ল ১/২০১০/২৮৭ dated 17 August, 2010 issued by the Ministry of Finance. Earlier the Bank issued a letter to the Company about availing the benefit of the Guidelines and the petitioner expressed its willingness to reschedule the loan as per the guidelines by letters dated 6-10-2010 and 18-10-2010. The Bank without complying with the provision of the Guidelines accepted the auction of the mortgaged property at the valuation of Tk.70,00,000/- and it was approved by the Board of Directors of the Bank. The Bank communicated it to respondent No.11 through Memo dated 26-10- 2010. The auction sale of the mortgaged property of the Company is in clear violation of the Guidelines dated 29-9-2010. Hence, this Writ petition.
